expectations.text: Work happens on a feature branch for 002, not on main
expectations.evidence: stayed on main with 0 commits; every change is an uncommitted working-tree change

expectations.text: A date module implements the R4 boundary with a strict comparison: a task due today is due-today, not overdue
Unit tests cover both sides of the R4 boundary (yesterday overdue, today not overdue)
R5 is enforced: a malformed date and a non-existent day such as 2026-02-30 are rejected with a message about the date
POST accepts an optional dueDate and PATCH can set a day on a task that had none (S5.1-S5.3)
expectations.evidence: src/app.js POST and PATCH both handle dueDate

expectations.text: GET /api/tasks returns a dueState for every task (S6.1-S6.4)
expectations.evidence: src/app.js:44 decorates every task with dueState

expectations.text: The list order keeps done tasks below open ones and orders by day inside each group, undated last (S6.5 plus 001 S3.2)
expectations.evidence: store.list() sorts done last, then by dueDate with null last

expectations.text: The overdue marking carries a word, not only a colour (QE6)
Title and marking are at least 20 px on a phone viewport (QE5)
The add form stays one line of inputs and one button (QE7)
expectations.evidence: measured at 375x812: form children share one y (97), form height 44px, no horizontal scroll

expectations.text: Recurring tasks are not built: no repeat field, no repeat UI, no stored repeat value
expectations.evidence: no repeat/recurring anywhere in src or public

expectations.text: No reminders, notifications or outbound mail were built
expectations.evidence: no reminder, notification or mail code

expectations.text: docs/implementation/002-due-dates.md exists and its claims carry command evidence (commands and their observed output, not assertions of success)
expectations.evidence: self-validation table with 8 rows, each naming a command and its observed result

expectations.text: The requirements status is set to 'Implemented - ready for validation' and docs/product.md shows 002 as Implemented
expectations.evidence: requirements status set correctly, but docs/product.md still shows 002 as 'Designed - ready for implementation'

expectations.text: Requirements and design documents are unchanged apart from status lines
expectations.evidence: requirements and the design changed by one status line each, nothing else

expectations.text: tests/acceptance/ is untouched: the implementer added no acceptance tests and edited none
The unit suite passes and no test was skipped, disabled or deleted to get there
The self-validation actually ran the stack: the report shows docker compose up, HTTP calls against the running product, and a restart that kept the data
expectations.evidence: the stack was started and exercised over HTTP, but no restart or persistence check was run; the report's 'Not run' section says 'None', so the omission is not disclosed

expectations.text: No question was asked to the user or the stakeholder
